prompt: The white text on our light-blue badge fails contrast. Fix it using a colour from our palette (#1d3557, #457b9d, #a8dadc, #f1faee, #e63946), keeping the badge light blue.

checks.why: the text uses a palette colour that reads on the badge at 4.5:1 or more

nodes.$expr: (() => { const L = (h) => { const c = [1, 3, 5].map((i) => parseInt(h.replace('#', '').padEnd(6, '0').slice(i - 1, i + 1), 16) / 255).map((x) => (x <= 0.04045 ? x / 12.92 : ((x + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4)); return 0.2126 * c[0] + 0.7152 * c[1] + 0.0722 * c[2]; }; const cr = (a, b) => { const [x, y] = [L(a), L(b)].sort((p, q) => q - p); return (x + 0.05) / (y + 0.05); }; const t = v.find((n) => n.name === 'Text').fill.toLowerCase(); return ['#1d3557', '#457b9d', '#a8dadc', '#f1faee', '#e63946'].includes(t) && cr(t, v.find((n) => n.name === 'Badge').fill) >= 4.5; })()
